_read_me: This is the only file you normally need to edit. Put your values between the quotes, then click 'Commit changes'. The website rebuilds itself within a few minutes.
_help_site_name: The name shown at the top of the website.
_help_site_url: Your full web address once it is live, e.g. https://www.aistatusnow.com  (or https://yourname.github.io/ai-status before you buy a domain). Leave empty until you know it.
_help_contact_email: Email shown in the footer and privacy page for people to contact you.
_help_request_form_url: Link to your Google Form for 'Request a tool' (the link you get from the form's Send button).
_help_adsense_client: Your AdSense publisher ID, looks like ca-pub-1234567890123456. Leave empty until you apply for AdSense.
_help_ad_slots: After AdSense approves you, create 3 'Display ads' units and paste each unit's slot number here (numbers only).
_help_verification: From Google Search Console / Bing Webmaster Tools: copy only the long code inside content="..." of their HTML tag.
_help_google_analytics_id: Optional. Google Analytics 4 measurement ID, looks like G-XXXXXXXXXX.
